tools.name: domain-security_domain-infrastructure-consistency-audit
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied DNS answers, certificate names, addresses, prefixes, and RPKI results for one domain. audit_status is consistent, inconsistencies_detected, warnings, or incomplete. risk_level is low, medium, high, or critical. No DNS, TLS, WHOIS, or BGP lookup is performed. Price $0.05 USDC.

tools.name: domain-security_infrastructure-health
tools.description: Look through the supplied DNS records, certificate names, expiry date, and cipher names. A CNAME whose target has no A or AAAA in the snapshot, a certificate that omits the domain, an expiry before the supplied date, a weak cipher name, or a missing NS record raises the exposure. tools.description: Compare a custom domain, tenant, ownership TXT records, DNS targets, and platform assignment status. tools.name: domain-security_onboarding-readiness
tools.description: Compare the supplied TXT name and token, the CNAME target, and a certificate flag. Readiness drops when the token is missing from the expected name, the CNAME does not match the target, or the certificate flag is false.
